meta.index.desc: Teide: Glide the Canaries — a minimalist paper-plane gliding game over the real Canary Islands. Ride the thermals, discover Points of Interest and land on real runways.
meta.og.desc: A minimalist paper-plane gliding game over the Canary Islands.
hero.title:
Glide over the
Canary Islands
hero.lead: A hand-folded paper plane, real terrain built from elevation data and nothing but thermals beneath your wings. Launch from the Teide, ride the updraughts and see how far you can glide — from La Gomera to Lanzarote.
hero.sceneAlt: Low-poly archipelago of the Canary Islands with the Teide volcano
pitch.quote: You folded the perfect paper plane and launched it from the slopes of the Teide. Now only one thing matters: staying up.
features.title: A game as calm as a glide
features.sub: No stress, no timer — just you, the wind and an archipelago built from real elevation data. Minimalist in look, surprisingly deep in detail.
feature.terrain.title: Real terrain
feature.terrain.body: The islands are built from real SRTM elevation data — from the 3,715 m high Teide to the dunes in the east.
feature.thermals.title: Thermals & updraughts
feature.thermals.body: Ride invisible updraughts to gain height. Read the thermals and you'll glide the furthest.
feature.poi.title: Points of Interest
feature.poi.body: Discover peaks, towns, beaches and landscapes. Fly through the rings and collect locations.
feature.runways.title: Runways & levels
feature.runways.body: Land cleanly on real airports and unlock them as new spawn points for your next flight.
feature.hangar.title: Hangar & upgrades
feature.hangar.body: Improve aerodynamics, top speed, stability and booster — and fold yourself the perfect glider.
feature.booster.title: Booster & range
feature.booster.body: Collect enough locations and your One-Shot booster grows — until the next island is within reach.
feature.look.title: Minimalist look
feature.look.body: A calm low-poly aesthetic in paper & ink. A clean HUD that never gets in the way.
feature.offline.title: Offline & fair
feature.offline.body: Runs entirely offline. No account, no purchase required — your progress stays on your device.
feature.achievements.title: Achievements & leaderboard
feature.achievements.body: 28 achievements and the “Best Flight” leaderboard via Google Play Games and Game Center — optional, the game runs without signing in.
feature.golden.title: Golden Wings
feature.golden.body: Every first landing in a run raises your multiplier. Golden Wings start higher and shine — but a crash landing costs them.
feature.controls.title: Three ways to steer
feature.controls.body: Joystick, two thumbs on the wings or tilting the device — plus auto-level when you let go. On desktop: keyboard.
feature.tutorial.title: Gentle start
feature.tutorial.body: A short tutorial with rings and thermals teaches launch, steering and boost — then game tips after every crash landing.
islands.title: Eight islands, one horizon
islands.sub: Hover an island, tap an airport — and the plane takes you there. Every runway is its own launch point in the game.
map.svgTitle: Map of the Canary Islands with all airports
trailer.title: See for yourself
screenshots.title: Four looks inside
screenshots.sub: Played in landscape — for the full view of the horizon.
trailer.aria: Trailer: 30 seconds of gliding over the Canaries, muted
trailer.note: Served from this site — no YouTube cookies.
screenshots.alt1: Teide: gliding through a thermal column over green highlands
screenshots.alt2: Teide: approaching the runway of a coastal airport
screenshots.alt3: Teide: paper plane over pine forest in front of a volcanic cone
screenshots.alt4: Teide: flying past the summit of the Teide with Point-of-Interest rings
cta.title: Ready to take off?
cta.body: Fold your plane, launch from the Teide and find out how far you can glide. Playable now in the browser, on the App Store and on Google Play.
footer.tagline: A minimalist paper-plane gliding game over the Canary Islands. Built with Three.js.

meta.licenses.title: Open-source licences — Teide
meta.licenses.desc: Open-source components and licences of the app Teide: Glide the Canaries.
licenses.intro: Teide stands on the shoulders of great open-source projects. The following components are included in the app; the full licence texts can be expanded below and are bundled with the app package.
licenses.three.summary: The 3D engine that renders terrain, plane and world. · threejs.org
licenses.capacitor.summary: The runtime bridge that packages the web app as a native iOS/Android app. · capacitorjs.com
licenses.admob.summary: Capacitor plugin that integrates Google AdMob (advertising) into the mobile apps. · github.com/capacitor-community/admob
licenses.revenuecat.summary: Capacitor plugin and native SDKs for in-app purchases via RevenueCat. · github.com/RevenueCat/purchases-capacitor
licenses.inconsolata.summary: The typeface used across the entire interface. · fonts.google.com
licenses.materialsymbols.summary: The icon font for HUD and menus (pause, map, booster …). · fonts.google.com/icons
licenses.sdks.title: Native platform SDKs
licenses.sdks.summary: The mobile apps also contain proprietary libraries from Google (Mobile Ads SDK, User Messaging Platform, Play Billing, Play Games Services) under the Google APIs Terms of Service or the Android SDK licence. On iOS, Apple’s system frameworks GameKit and StoreKit are used.
licenses.audio.summary: Sound effects from Pixabay, used under the Pixabay Content Licence. Music composed by Daniel Schultes.
licenses.icons.summary: The “Golden Wings” icon (“Feather Wing”) comes from SVG Repo and is free for commercial use.
licenses.ai.title: AI transparency
licenses.ai.summary: Parts of the artwork (e.g. store and website graphics) and the translations of the app and website were created with the assistance of generative AI and editorially reviewed. The app itself contains no AI systems.

meta.privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Teide
meta.privacy.desc: Privacy Policy for the website and the app Teide: Glide the Canaries.
privacy.intro: Protecting your personal data is important to us. This Privacy Policy informs you about which data is processed when you visit this website and when you use the app “Teide: Glide the Canaries”. The processing is governed by the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), where applicable, as well as by the Swiss Data Protection Act (DSG).
privacy.s1.body: Responsible for the data processing in connection with this website and the app is:
privacy.s2.p1: This Privacy Policy applies to (1) this website, through which the app is presented, and (2) the mobile app “Teide”, a minimalist gliding game.
privacy.s2.p2: The app is an offline-capable single-player game. We operate no servers of our own and maintain no user accounts. Beyond the processing of in-app purchases (RevenueCat, see section 4.5), advertising in the mobile apps (Google AdMob, see section 4.6) and the optional platform game services (Google Play Games or Apple Game Center, see section 4.7), no further tracking, analytics or advertising services are integrated.
privacy.s3.hosting.p1: This website is provided via GitHub Pages, a service of GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA. When the website is accessed, GitHub, as a technical service provider, automatically processes connection data (server log files) in order to enable the delivery of the pages and to ensure security. This may in particular include:
privacy.s3.hosting.list:
• IP address of the requesting device
  • date and time of access
  • name and URL of the retrieved file
  • browser and operating system used (user agent)
  • amount of data transferred / status code
privacy.s3.hosting.p2: The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in a secure and functional provision of the website) or the Swiss DSG. We ourselves do not operate any web servers of our own and do not evaluate these log data. Details on the processing by GitHub can be found in the GitHub Privacy Policy.
privacy.s3.cookies.body: This website sets no cookies and uses no analytics, tracking or advertising tools. No profiling and no reach measurement takes place. The only thing stored is your language choice, in your browser’s local storage (localStorage), so that the site appears in the same language on your next visit. This entry contains no personal data, is transmitted neither to us nor to third parties and can be deleted at any time via your browser settings.
privacy.s3.fonts.body: Fonts are embedded locally and are delivered directly from this website. No external font services (e.g. Google Fonts CDN) are loaded, so that when a page is accessed no data is transmitted to third parties for this purpose.
privacy.s3.contact.body: If you contact us by email, we process the information you provide (e.g. email address, content of the message) solely in order to handle your enquiry. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR. The data are deleted as soon as they are no longer required for the purpose and provided that no statutory retention obligations preclude this.
privacy.s4.local.p1: The app stores your game progress and your settings solely locally on your device (in the local app/browser storage). This includes, for example:
privacy.s4.local.list:
• game state (e.g. points, collected locations, purchased upgrades, unlocked airports, discovered Points of Interest)
  • graphics and quality settings
  • selected language
privacy.s4.local.p2: This data contains no personal information (no name, no contact details, no location). It remains on your device — we as the provider have no access to it.
privacy.s4.servers.body: The app sends no technical data (e.g. IP address, device ID, usage analytics) to servers of our own. No analytics libraries or crash-reporting services are used. There is no registration or login obligation. Third parties are involved in three cases: the processing of in-app purchases (see section 4.5), advertising in the mobile apps via Google AdMob (see section 4.6) and the optional game services Google Play Games or Apple Game Center (see section 4.7).
privacy.s4.permissions.body: The app requires no special device permissions such as camera, microphone, location or access to your contacts/photos. If you choose tilt controls in the settings, the app asks once for access to the motion sensors on iOS; the sensor values are used solely on the device for steering and are not transmitted. On Android, the app uses the advertising-ID permission for advertising (see section 4.6).
privacy.s4.stores.h: 4.4 Obtaining the app via app stores
privacy.s4.stores.p1: The app is provided via the app stores of Apple (App Store) and Google (Google Play). When downloading and using the stores, the respective operators independently process data (e.g. account data, device information, download statistics) on their own responsibility. We have no influence over this; the privacy provisions of the respective provider apply:
privacy.s4.stores.list:
• Apple — Privacy Policy
  • Google — Privacy Policy
privacy.s4.iap.p1: The app offers, or will offer, paid in-app content (e.g. a premium currency or additional content). The actual payment processing is carried out exclusively via the respective app-store operator — Apple (App Store) or Google (Google Play Billing). In doing so, Apple or Google independently process the data required for the purchase (e.g. Apple ID/Google account, payment data, transaction ID).
privacy.s4.iap.p2: We as the provider receive merely the information as to whether a particular product has been purchased or unlocked, but no payment details (no credit card numbers or the like). The purchase status is processed in order to unlock the content and is, as a rule, stored locally on your device.
privacy.s4.iap.p3: For the technical processing, validation and restoration of in-app purchases, we use the service RevenueCat (RevenueCat, Inc., USA) as a processor. On our behalf, RevenueCat processes in particular an anonymised app user ID (no real name), purchase and transaction events, the purchase history as well as technical device and usage data (e.g. platform, app version, country). The purpose is the correct unlocking and restoration of purchases as well as fraud prevention. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of a contract) or Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in reliable purchase processing). Further information: RevenueCat Privacy Policy.
privacy.s4.iap.p4: The legal basis for the processing in the context of in-app purchases is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of a contract), where applicable, as well as the Swiss DSG. Further information on the processing by the store operators can be found in their privacy policies linked above.
privacy.s4.ads.body: The Android and iOS apps integrate Google AdMob (Google Ireland Ltd.) and show interstitial and rewarded-video ads. In doing so, device and usage identifiers — in particular the advertising ID (on iOS, the IDFA), an approximate location derived from the IP address, and app interaction data — are processed to deliver and measure the advertising and transmitted to Google. Where required, we obtain your consent in advance: on Android via a consent dialog (Google UMP), and on iOS additionally via Apple’s App Tracking Transparency (ATT) prompt; without consent, only non-personalised ads are served. You can reset your advertising ID or withdraw tracking at any time in your Android or iOS settings. The optional “remove ads” purchase permanently disables interstitial ads. The web version contains no advertising. For more information, see Google’s Privacy Policy.
privacy.s4.games.h: 4.7 Game services: Google Play Games & Apple Game Center
privacy.s4.games.p1: The mobile apps optionally integrate the game services of the respective platform: Google Play Games (Google Play Games Services, Google Ireland Ltd.) on Android and Apple Game Center (Apple Inc.) on iOS. Through them, the app offers achievements and the “Best Flight” leaderboard. On launch, the app checks whether your device is already signed in to the service; if so, the connection is established automatically. Otherwise you can sign in via the settings – on iOS the system may also offer the Game Center sign-in on first launch, which you can cancel. The game is fully playable without signing in.
privacy.s4.games.p2: If you are signed in, the app transmits unlocked achievements and your best flight score to Google or Apple. There they are assigned to your player profile and – depending on your settings there – shown to other players in the leaderboard. In return, the app receives only your player display name for display in the settings; it is not transmitted to us and not stored permanently. The processing by Google or Apple takes place on their own responsibility under the privacy policies linked in section 4.4. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (provision of the function you use) or the Swiss DSG. You can sign out at any time in the Google Play Games app or in the iOS settings under Game Center.
privacy.s5.intro: Insofar as the GDPR is applicable, the processing is based in particular on:
privacy.s5.list:
• Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR — performance of (pre-)contractual obligations (e.g. handling of enquiries, processing of in-app purchases, game services)
  • Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR — legitimate interest (secure, stable provision of website and app)
privacy.s5.swiss: For users in Switzerland, the processing is carried out in accordance with the Swiss Data Protection Act (DSG).
privacy.s6.body: Data stored locally in the app remains on your device until you reset it in the app (the “Reset game progress” function in the settings) or uninstall the app. Since no personal data is stored on servers of our own, no separate storage period exists there. For the data processed by GitHub or the app-store operators, their own retention periods apply.
privacy.s7.body: Your data is not disclosed to third parties — except to the technically necessary service providers for the operation of the website (GitHub Pages), the provision of the app via the app stores (Apple, Google), the processing of in-app purchases (RevenueCat as a processor), advertising in the mobile apps (Google AdMob) and the optional game services (Google Play Games, Apple Game Center), in each case on their own responsibility or on our behalf.
privacy.s8.body: With hosting via GitHub Pages, the use of the app stores, advertising via Google AdMob, the game services of Google and Apple, as well as the processing of in-app purchases via RevenueCat, processing may take place in countries outside Switzerland and the EU/EEA (in particular in the USA). The aforementioned providers base such transfers on appropriate safeguards within the meaning of Art. 44 et seq. GDPR (e.g. EU standard contractual clauses). Details can be found in the respective privacy policies linked above.
privacy.s9.intro: Insofar as the GDPR or the Swiss DSG applies to you, you have — depending on the legal framework — in particular the following rights:
privacy.s9.list:
• right of access
  • right to rectification
  • right to erasure
  • right to restriction of processing
  • right to data portability
  • right to object to certain processing
  • right to withdraw consent given, with effect for the future
privacy.s9.p2: Since the app transmits no personal data to us, we cannot practically exercise many of these rights ourselves — we simply do not see your data. You can delete your locally stored data yourself at any time (reset in the app or uninstallation). For any concerns, please feel free to contact us by email: swissinnovationstudios@gmail.com.
privacy.s9.p3: In addition, you have a right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority — in Switzerland with the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC), in the EU/EEA with the data protection supervisory authority responsible for your place of residence.
privacy.s10.body: The website is delivered via an encrypted connection (HTTPS/TLS). Locally stored app data is accessible only via your device and its operating system. Please take care yourself to maintain appropriate device security (e.g. device PIN, no unauthorised access by third parties).
privacy.s11.body: We may adapt this Privacy Policy if functions of the website or app or the legal requirements change. The current version published here applies in each case.
privacy.faq.body: If anything about data protection is unclear, we are happy to help: swissinnovationstudios@gmail.com.
